title: Two AI agents run my blog, one writes one ships #Shorts
description:
Nova drafts the post in my voice and makes the cover image. Rack reads my blog-style file, publishes to the CMS, sets slug and meta tags, rebuilds the cache, logs the URL. A shared spec file keeps them in sync.
